mobbin:a2ee58b7-b7cc-4381-819b-3dc029973.summary: From a dashboard's 'Subscribe' button, the user sets up a recurring email or Slack delivery with a one-line schedule, a CSV file and subscribers, then edits the saved subscription.
steps: Dashboard header with Subscribe and Share
Subscribe window: schedule sentence, CSV, add subscribers
Success message and editable subscribed row, then Done
steal: The schedule reads as one sentence, 'Every [day] at [time]', with a CSV attachment (screen 2).
A time zone line ('Showing times as...') sits above the schedule, so recipients on different campuses share one clock (screens 2 to 3).
After saving, a green message appears and the schedule stays editable, so you can pause or change it without starting over (screen 3).
A search box under the schedule adds subscribers, which supports digests for people who may not have an account (screens 2 to 3).
avoid: CSV is the only default format, but deans need a PDF or a written newsletter rather than a raw data file (screens 2 to 3).
mobbin:a2ee58b7-b7cc-4381-819b-3dc029973.fit: Reports: the closest pattern for automatic weekly or monthly digests for deans from a fixed dashboard. It is a ready-made subscription instead of packs put together by hand.
